--delete-orphans.help: Delete samples where the target object no longer exists

--depth.help: Profondeur maximale des chemins à explorer (optionnel)

--dest-dir.help: Destination directory to save backup files (default: ./db_backup)

--dir.help: Path to directory containing locale JSON files (default: frontend/messages).

--dry-run.help: Show what would be deleted without actually deleting

--email.help: The email address used for Jira authentication.

--embedding-model.help: Ollama embedding model to use (e.g., nomic-embed-text, mxbai-embed-large). If specified, embeddings will be generated and passed as context to the LLM.

--error-log.help: Path to the error log file (default: "convert_v1_to_v2_errors.log").

--excel-root.help: Root folder of converted Excel files (default: "tools/excel").

--excel-suffix-fallback.help: Suffix to try when a path from success log no longer exists (default: "_NEW").

--execution-log.help: Detailed execution log that captures convert_library_v2 output.

--failure-out-log.help: Log file listing files with no matching YAML.

--favor-equals.help: For each source item, show only "equal" relationships if available, otherwise show all matches

--file.help: Path to local NVD JSON response file

--folder-id.help: The UUID of the Folder to associate this integration with.

--force.help: Overwrite destination files if they exist without prompting

--fresh.help: Delete existing test data and create fresh data

--host.help: Host to bind the metrics server to (default: 0.0.0.0)

--include-no-relationship.help: Include 'no_relationship' mappings in output (default: exclude them)

--items-only.help: Output only the items list (not metadata)

--json.help: Emit aggregate as JSON instead of a human report

--keep.help: keep downloaded sources and intermediate Excel workbooks

--keep-empty-sections.help: keep sections that contain no assessable recommendation (e.g. 'Introduction')

--library-version.help: CISO Assistant library version (bump when re-extracting a newer benchmark edition under the same ref_id so instances see an update)

--load-missing-libraries.help: Load libraries referenced by the dump that are missing on the target.

--max-depth.help: Maximum depth of the folder hierarchy (default: 4)

--min-version.help: floor for the library version. The file on disk cannot know what has already been stored or loaded elsewhere; pass the highest version that exists anywhere so a rebuild never collides with it (a same-urn, same-version import is silently discarded by StoredLibrary).

--model.help: Only process a specific model type

--models.help: Specific models to index (e.g. core.AppliedControl). Defaults to all indexed models.

--name.help: Name for the created object. Defaults to an auto-generated timestamped name.

--no-page-break.help: Do not include '--- PAGE X ---' separators

--no-update.help: Disable automatic metric updates (metrics will only be updated on request)

--old-output-dir.help: Output directory for renamed .old files (only used with --bulk mode).

--old-root.help: Root folder for .old files (default: sibling "#old_excel" next to excel root).

--older-than-days.help: Custom retention period in days (overrides global setting)

--on-conflict.help: How to handle existing records: stop (default), skip, or update.

--output-dir.help: Output directory for YAML files (only used with --bulk mode).

--output-suffix.help: Suffix added just before ".xlsx" for converted files (example: "_v2").

--pat.help: Personal Access Token; prefer the env var to keep it out of shell history [env CISO_PAT]

--periodic.help: Number of periodic tasks to create (default: 20)

--port.help: Port to run the metrics server on (default: 8001)

--purge.help: Delete all samples (use with --model to target a specific model)

--recreate.help: Drop and recreate the collection if it already exists

--regenerate.help: Regenerate today's snapshots after cleanup (use with --purge)

--rename.help: errata override: replace the extracted title of REF (repeatable); use when the PDF's summary table contradicts the recommendation body

--requirements-only.help: Keep only rows from ref_id "3.1" and shift depth to depth-1.

--resource.help: url model exposing /full/, e.g. applied-controls, assets [env CISO_RESOURCE]

--resume.help: Resume from existing output files if they exist

--reverse.help: Expand using source_node_id instead of target_node_id

--server-url.help: The base URL of the Jira server (e.g., https://my-company.atlassian.net).

--skip-context.help: Use only item description without parent context aggregation (default: include parent context)

--skip-historical.help: Skip migrating historical data, only generate today's snapshots

--skip-post-hooks.help: Skip re-triggering ComplianceAssessment metrics and CEL outcome evaluation for touched audits.

--skip-validation.help: Skip validation that target URNs exist in --controls-file

--source.help: Only delete advisories from this source (CVE, EUVD, GHSA, other)

--source-attachments.help: Path to source attachments directory (default: MEDIA_ROOT from settings)

--source-db.help: Path to source SQLite database (default: current database from settings)

--source-fr.help: French source workbook path used to fill [fr] columns.

--success-out-log.help: Log file listing matched YAMLs and compatibility mode.

--suffix.help: Suffix added to converted files before ".xlsx" (default: "_NEW").

--sync.help: Run synchronously instead of queuing as a background task

--target.help: Target locale to compare against (optional, default all locales).

--test.help: Utilise des données de test simulées (1000 frameworks, pivots, etc.)

--top.help: Show top N sessions by avg prompt tokens (default: 5)

--top-n.help: Return top N matches per source item (default: 1)

--update.help: Update the remote_id if a mapping for this control already exists.

--update-interval.help: Interval in seconds to update metrics (default: 60)

--use-labels.help: Use ref_ids as axis labels instead of indices

--verbose.help: Enable verbose output. Verbose messages start with a 💬 (speech bubble) emoji.

--verify-hashes/--no-verify-hashes.help: Verify file hashes before upload (default: True)

--workers.help: concurrent workers for detail mode [env CISO_WORKERS]
